name: RECURRING DECIMAL TRICK
description:
1. Jo sankhya dikh rahi hai use decimal hata kar likho।

2. Jis number par bar hai,
   use chhupa do।

3. Ab jo number dikh raha hai,
   use minus mein likho।

4. Denominator mein:
   • Jitne digit par bar hai utne 9 likho।
   • Decimal ke baad aur bar se pehle
     jitne digit hain utne 0 lagao।


EXAMPLE 1:
0.4̅

4 - 0
-----
9

= 4/9


EXAMPLE 2:
3.35̅

335 - 33
--------
90

= 302/90


EXAMPLE 3:
3.23̅

323 - 32
---------
90

= 291/90
= 97/30


EXAMPLE 4:
3.257̅

3257 - 32
----------
990

= 3225/990
= 215/66
